name: Generalised average rule
summary: Two H-boxes on the same Z-spiders, connected through a NOT, average their labels.
description: The !-box generalisation of the [average rule](../zh-average/): two H-boxes with labels $a$ and $b$ that are connected to the same set of Z-spiders, and to each other via a NOT gate, combine into a single H-box with label $\frac{a+b}{2}$ (and a scalar factor 2).
parameter_notes: Shown for H-boxes connected to n = 2 Z-spiders; holds for any n.

also_in.location: Lemma 3.8 (in the sum form of the average rule)

notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
